title: Window Max
commonMistakes: Scanning each window from scratch, which gives O(n * k) time
Removing only the current maximum and losing the next-best candidate
Using the array value instead of the index to detect when an element leaves the window
followUps: How would you return the minimum of every window instead?
What changes if k is larger than the array?
Can you adapt the same idea to a stream where elements arrive one at a time?
attribution: Problem statement, explanation, and solutions by the Base Case contributors. Example and test provenance is under audit.
